server.name: io.github.AtlasDevHQ/atlas
server.description: Atlas is a YAML-defined semantic layer for analytics — authored by humans, consumed by AI agents.
server.title: Atlas

environmentVariables.description: Analytics datasource URL (postgres, mysql, clickhouse, snowflake, duckdb, bigquery, salesforce). Optional — falls back to a bundled NovaMart SQLite demo when unset.
environmentVariables.name: ATLAS_DATASOURCE_URL

environmentVariables.description: LLM provider: anthropic, openai, bedrock, ollama, openai-compatible, gateway. Optional — the MCP server does not call an LLM directly (the client does); set this only if you also run Atlas's chat or scheduler.
environmentVariables.name: ATLAS_PROVIDER

environmentVariables.description: URL of a running Atlas API. Optional — defaults to http://localhost:3001. When set, the MCP server inherits the API's connections, semantic layer, and governance.
environmentVariables.name: ATLAS_API_URL

server.name: io.github.Augustas11/antfeed-mcp
server.description: Discover and transact on the AntSeed P2P AI network from any MCP-compatible agent.

environmentVariables.description: Base URL for the AntFeed Explorer REST API.

environmentVariables.description: Local AntSeed buyer RPC URL. Required only for the transactional `create_session` tool; omit for read-only use.

environmentVariables.description: Defense-in-depth ceiling on `create_session` deposits, in USDC. Hard-capped at 10000.
environmentVariables.name: ANTSEED_MAX_DEPOSIT_USDC

environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to require the local buyer to identify itself via /health. Recommended on shared dev boxes.
environmentVariables.name: ANTSEED_BUYER_STRICT
